name: vibe-coding-guardrail
description: Antigravity-native Python plugin with deterministic lifecycle hooks (hooks.json), a 3-Stage loop, and 6 skills (vibe-coder, aos-vibecode, aos-verify, aos-check-for-security-issues, aos-audit-project, aos-vibecode-update).
suggestedPrompts: Start a vibe-coder session: scope, plan, and implement the next feature from INITIATIVE.md
Run aos-audit-project: audit this repository against Architecture.md and ask which optimizations to apply
Run /aos-vibecode-update: update the guardrail plugin, prune merged branches, and sync AGENTS.md
